newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel international projects to equal home mkt.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel international projects to equal home mkt.

text.p: Belgian utility holding company Tractebel SA said on Tuesday its electricity production abroad was well on the way to equalling its home market Belgium.

"It is not utopic to say that by the year 2,000 we will produce as much electricity abroad as we produce in Belgium," Tractebel chief executive officer Philippe Bodson told a news conference on 1996 earnings.
Tractebel today also announced a merger with its unit Powerfin, which spearheaded its foreign expansion in since the early nineties.
Tractebel owns 39 percent of Electrabel, which has installed electricity generating capacity of 13,000 megawatts in Belgium.
Abroad, the Tractebel group has stakes in power plants in 15 countries, with total capacity of 9,576 megawatt, in which Tractebel has a group stake of about 40 percent.
